title: Reinstatement Fee Payments on an Expired Homesite Reservation
content:
The reinstatement fee charged for reinstating an expired Homesite Reservation hold is received as one payment booked with the component reinstatement fee on the reservation ledger, in the amount of the reinstatement fee charged.

## Business effect

The buyer's reinstatement fee payment, taken over the phone, is posted to the ledger of the expired Homesite Reservation as one payment received, booked as the reinstatement fee component, dated the day it is taken, with a new Calloway receipt number. The money then shows among the funds held on the reservation. The reservation's status and hold dates are not changed by the payment.

## Invocation: `record_reinstatement_fee_fa042025`

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `record_reinstatement_fee_fa042025` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `reservation_id` | the reference number of the expired Homesite Reservation the fee is for, as returned by the Homesite Reservation lookup for the buyer | identifier |
| `customer_id` | the customer reference number of the paying buyer, as returned by the customer profile lookup | identifier |
| `amount` | the reinstatement fee taken, in USD | positive amount to 2 decimal places (cents), booked exactly as entered, with no further rounding |
| `payment_method` | how the buyer pays: `card` (debit or credit card), `ach` (bank transfer from a checking or savings account), `check` (personal check), `wire` (wire transfer from the buyer's bank), `certified_funds` (cashier's check or other certified funds) | exactly one of the five values |
| `source_payment_ref` | when this payment replaces a payment of the buyer's that was returned unpaid, the receipt number of that returned payment exactly as it appears on the reservation ledger; an empty string when it replaces no returned payment | verbatim |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `homesite_event_id` (the reference number of the ledger entry created), `payment_reference` (the new Calloway receipt number printed for this payment), `deposit_component` (always "reinstatement_fee"), `amount` (the amount posted, USD with 2 decimal places) and `event_date` (the posting date, YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt carrying a `payment_reference` means the payment posted.

## Contract questions

**Does posting the fee bring the hold back?** No. The payment changes neither the reservation's status nor its hold dates.

**Is the method recorded?** Yes; the payment is booked with the `payment_method` given, and the ledger entry shows it.
